parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Surrey · Whalley and City Centre

Bolivar Heights is an MLS® area in North Surrey, north of City Centre. Two large City parks sit in it: Bolivar Park and Invergarry Park. The City Centre Plan update allows for growth in the Bolivar Heights area, including a mixed-use neighbourhood centre. On the MLS® map, between about 137 and 145 Street it starts around 108 Avenue, north of Whalley.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 13, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Surrey and Surrey Schools.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

Bolivar Heights is an MLS® area name in Surrey. On the MLS® map it runs north of City Centre, around Bolivar Park and Invergarry Park. Between about 137 and 145 Street it starts around 108 Avenue, north of Whalley. It sits close to Bridgeview and Whalley near 124 Street, where the areas share some of the same streets. These edges are approximate and are not an official City boundary, so ask me if a specific address is in it.
